response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “One specific thing…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“within the plain communities”","suggested_fix":"Replace “konserwatiewe Anabaptistiese gemeenskappe” with “plain-gemeenskappe” (or another established Afrikaans equivalent that does not identify them specifically as Anabaptist).","translation_quote":"“binne die konserwatiewe Anabaptistiese gemeenskappe”"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “Too many times…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“since it is their lot in life and we are too busy to be bothered”","suggested_fix":"Revise to preserve the source’s point that the church treats their struggle as simply their lot in life, while the church is too busy to be bothered; for example: “omdat hulle swaarkry as maar hul lot in die lewe beskou word en ons te besig is om ons daaraan te steur.”","translation_quote":"“omdat hulle glo dit is maar hoe die lewe vir hulle is en ons te besig is om ons daarmee te bemoei”"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “Too many times…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"“leave sleeping dogs lie” or that it would be best to not “open that can of worms”","suggested_fix":"Use the idiomatic Afrikaans equivalent for not raising a troublesome issue, such as “laat slapende honde lê” and “maak nie daardie blikkie wurms oop nie.”","translation_quote":"“slapende honde te laat lê” or … “die wurmpies uit die blikkie te laat kom”"}],"passed":false,"score":88}
